verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's core Funnels report explicitly measures conversion through a series of events, and its Query API supports filtering and breaking down events plus returning cohorts, directly matching multi-step funnels with filters/breakdowns to find drop-off; docs even market 'discover critical drop-off points' and pair funnels with Session Replay to explore why users drop off. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on reviewer confirmation of the funnel-building UX itself (only vendor docs), and no explicit detail on saved funnel breakdown-by-property mechanics beyond general Query API description.
